title: Make Git identity the default review freeze and drop mandatory raw review identity
outcome: Make Git identity the default review freeze and drop mandatory raw review identity
acceptance: /review-changes defines the review freeze as Git identity: a fully staged index, an empty git diff, no untracked files, and the git write-tree id that each reviewer reports at start and end; for committed inputs, the commit tree id plus a clean status.
The compiled host freeze checker and raw review identity are optional, limited to the listed raw-byte exceptions.
The launcher's automatic before/after fingerprint is unchanged.

completion.summary: The review freeze is now Git identity by default: a staged index, an empty git diff, no untracked files and the git write-tree id, checked by each reviewer at start and end, or for committed inputs the commit tree id plus a clean status. Raw review identity and the compiled freeze checker are optional, only for the listed raw-byte cases. The launcher fingerprint is unchanged, and AGENTS.md == CLAUDE.md. Landed in 0ec2e141, pushed and installed (build 4bc4a203). The independent evaluation 596b2748 passed 4/4.
